scope: Two already completed V7 runs; read-only analysis; not a new model run or kernel benchmark.

clockDefinitions.model: Local harness observation timestamps for paired model_invocation_started/completed events; includes observation delay; not isolated provider service time.
clockDefinitions.tools: Product projection started_at/finished_at; includes the entire host tool operation, not only kernel computation.
clockDefinitions.union: Merge overlapping intervals within each category. Different clock sources/categories are not an exact additive partition of run time.

limitations: One creation and one modification; no average, percentile, speedup or cross-model claim.
The two timing categories use distinct clocks and must not be subtracted to claim exact unaccounted overhead.
No private reasoning, tool arguments, user files or credentials included.
Current model settings, frozen catalog, runtime and artifact records were not changed.
Kernel export timings are measured separately under a different workload.
